title: Recent rounds
description: How the last rounds on this venue settled. A long streak one way says something about the trend, and about how the crowd will lean next.

streak_direction.label: Streak direction
streak_direction.description: Whether the current run of settlements is Up or Down. None right after the streak breaks.

streak_length.label: Streak length
streak_length.description: How many rounds in a row have settled the same way. Long streaks draw momentum bets and contrarian bets alike.

up_share_8.label: Up in last 8
up_share_8.description: The share of the last eight rounds that settled Up, as a percentage. Fifty is balanced.
